summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results press release (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2) for the period ended September 30, 2026. The release reports stable organic revenue growth, a 6% decline in adjusted operating income and a 19% reported operating income drop, with reported net income down 42% mainly on one-time China strategy refinement costs. EPS was stable, aided by the share buyback. Full-year 2026 revenue is seen broadly flat and operating income flat to negative mid-single-digit. No transaction, stake, price or deal mechanics are disclosed; this is ordinary earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
